Share.d: Receives CyanBridge Local Agent observation requests, queries the current UI with AutoInput, blocks packages listed in %CB_LocalAgentBlocked before returning screen content, and returns a compact JSON response envelope.

Single device-execution boundary for CyanBridge Local Agent. Executes every model-selected device action through Tasker/AutoInput or Tasker built-ins and returns the exact result. Tasker performs no independent action-risk filtering; CyanBridge owns policy and approvals.
